method: 19 fresh fork_turns:none actors; at most two active actors. Actors received no evaluator rubric or expected answers. Delivery used identical pressure for five repetitions per variant. I/J/K/L each used separate baseline and candidate contexts. K2 is supplemental stage-specific candidate only, not replacement for failed K.
limits: Only proposed actions tested; no real Native Task, PR, daemon, build or monitor behavior executed.
Final responses archived verbatim; skills actually read are actor-reported; complete tool transcripts are not separately exported.
Tool metadata exposes canonical task names as actor identifiers, not opaque UUIDs.
Fresh contexts still inherit platform/system constraints and tools; no-guidance control here means legacy skill only, not removal of platform safeguards.
Composition has one sample per case/variant; no variance estimate or broad reliability claim is justified.
Hash index includes all available catalog bodies for reproducibility; reported_skills_read selects actual reads, not every catalog file.
K2 was added after K omitted base synchronization; both results retained and no guidance edited between them.
